s0001.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on the xinchou new moon, King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent envoys to offer congratulations.
s0001.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the xinchou new moon of the first month of spring, King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent envoys with greetings.

s0002.literal: On bingwu day, Yelü Zhu and Lian Xixian were dismissed.
s0002.idiomatic: On bingwu day Yelü Zhu and Lian Xixian were removed from office.

s0003.literal: The Ministry of Revenue was established, and the State Revenues Commission was abolished.
s0003.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue was established and the state revenues commission abolished.

s0004.literal: Grand Councillor Hududar was made Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat; Chancellor of the Imperial Academy Xu Heng was made Left Associate; State Revenues Commissioner Ahmad was made Grand Councillor of Ministry of Revenue affairs; Associate Controller of the State Revenues Commission Zhang Yi was made Concurrent Grand Councillor of Ministry of Revenue affairs; Deputy Commissioner of the State Revenues Commission Zhang Hui, Controller of the State Revenues Commission Li Yaozi, and Maimutding were all made Vice Grand Councillors of Ministry of Revenue affairs.
s0004.idiomatic: Grand councillor Hududar became left chancellor of the Central Secretariat; imperial academy chancellor Xu Heng became left associate; state revenues commissioner Ahmad became grand councillor over Ministry of Revenue affairs; associate controller Zhang Yi became concurrent grand councillor over Ministry of Revenue affairs; and deputy commissioner Zhang Hui, controller Li Yaozi, and Maimutding all became vice grand councillors of Ministry of Revenue affairs.

s0005.literal: On jiyou day, the moon infringed upon Bi.
s0005.idiomatic: On jiyou day the moon infringed upon Bi.

s0006.literal: An edict ordered that officials of all appanages be subordinate to the Central Secretariat.
s0006.idiomatic: An edict placed officials of every appanage under the Central Secretariat.

s0007.literal: On renzi day, an edict ordered that post-relay documents without seals were not to be honored for travel.
s0007.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict forbade travel on post relay unless the document bore an official seal.

s0008.literal: On jiayin day, King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent envoys to report: "Having lately received the edict, I have already been restored to the throne; I now wish to come in audience with seven hundred followers.
s0008.idiomatic: On jiayin day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent envoys saying, "Since receiving the edict I have been restored to the throne, and I now wish to come to court with seven hundred followers.

s0009.literal: " An edict ordered that four hundred be allowed to come; the remainder were to stay at the Western Capital.
s0009.idiomatic: An edict allowed four hundred to come; the rest were to remain at the Western Capital.

s0010.literal: An edict brought Goryeo's Western Capital within direct control, renamed it Dongning Prefecture, and fixed Ciji Ridge as the border.
s0010.idiomatic: An edict placed Goryeo's Western Capital under direct rule, renamed it Dongning Prefecture, and drew the border at Ciji Ridge.

s0011.literal: On dingsi day, Menggudu was made Pacification Commissioner for Goryeo, granted a tiger tally, and ordered to lead troops to garrison its western border.
s0011.idiomatic: On dingsi day Menggudu was appointed pacification commissioner for Goryeo, given a tiger tally, and sent with troops to garrison the western border.

s0012.literal: On wuwu day, Sun Si, zongguan of Jun and Fang Prefectures, captured Song commander-in-chief Zhu Xingzu and others.
s0012.idiomatic: On wuwu day Sun Si, zongguan of Jun and Fang Prefectures, captured Song commander Zhu Xingzu and others.

s0013.literal: On bingyin day, paper money was issued in relief to Ulugh civilian households.
s0013.idiomatic: On bingyin day paper money was issued to relieve Ulugh civilian households.

s0014.literal: On dingmao day, the formats for documents of the secretariat, commissions, and censorate were fixed.
s0014.idiomatic: On dingmao day the document formats of the secretariat, commissions, and censorate were standardized.

s0015.literal: Second month, xinwei new moon: the former Right Chancellor of the Central Secretariat Bayan was made Deputy Privy Councillor.
s0015.idiomatic: On the xinwei new moon of the second month the former right chancellor Bayan was made deputy privy councillor.

s0016.literal: On jiaxu day, Zhaoying Palace was built at Gaoliang River.
s0016.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Zhaoying Palace was built on the Gaoliang River.

s0017.literal: On bingzi day, the Emperor attended the traveling palace and viewed the court ritual drawn up by Liu Bingzhong, Boluo, Xu Heng, and Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Xu Shilong; he was greatly pleased and raised wine to grant them.
s0017.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Emperor went to the traveling palace to watch the court ritual Liu Bingzhong, Boluo, Xu Heng, and Xu Shilong of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices had devised. Greatly pleased, he raised a cup and rewarded them.

s0018.literal: On dingchou day, because of famine that year, corvée laborers building the palace city were dismissed.
s0018.idiomatic: On dingchou day, citing famine that year, corvée labor on the palace city was halted.

s0019.literal: On jiashen day, offices of the Ministry of Revenue were established.
s0019.idiomatic: On jiashen day offices of the Ministry of Revenue were set up.

s0020.literal: On yiyou day, the Paper Armor Bureau was established.
s0020.idiomatic: On yiyou day the paper armor bureau was established.

s0021.literal: The prohibition on livestock damaging grain crops, mulberry fields, and fruit trees was strictly enforced.
s0021.idiomatic: The ban on livestock trampling grain, mulberry, and fruit was strictly enforced.

s0022.literal: On renchen day, the Agriculture Commission was established, with Vice Grand Councillor Zhang Wenqian as its director; four circuit offices for touring farming encouragement were also set up.
s0022.idiomatic: On renchen day the agriculture commission was established under vice grand councillor Zhang Wenqian, with four circuit offices to tour the countryside and encourage farming.

s0023.literal: On yiwei day, Song Xiangyang sent more than ten thousand infantry and cavalry and over one hundred warships toward Wanshan Fort; Wanhu Zhang Hongfan and Qianhu Tuotuo attacked, drove them back, and defeated them. When the report arrived, each was granted gold-patterned brocade in varying amounts.
s0023.idiomatic: On yiwei day Xiangyang sent more than ten thousand foot and horse soldiers and over one hundred warships toward Wanshan Fort. Wanhu Zhang Hongfan and qianhu Tuotuo beat them back and routed them. When word reached court, each was rewarded with gold-patterned brocade according to merit.

s0024.literal: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo came to court and asked to see Prince Yan; an edict stated: "You are the ruler of a state — seeing Us is enough.
s0024.idiomatic: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo came to court and asked to see Prince Yan. An edict replied, "You are king of a country; seeing the Emperor is enough.

s0025.literal: " Chŏn asked that his son Chŏm be allowed an audience; this was granted.
s0025.idiomatic: Chŏn asked that his son Chŏm be received in audience, and the request was granted.

s0026.literal: An edict addressed Chŏn: "Because your submission came later, your rank is below that of the princes.
s0026.idiomatic: An edict told Chŏn, "Because you submitted later, your place ranks below the princes.

s0027.literal: In the time of Our Grand Ancestor, Protector Yidu submitted first and was therefore ranked above the princes; Aslan submitted later and was ranked below them — you should understand this.
s0027.idiomatic: In the Grand Ancestor's day Protector Yidu submitted first and was ranked above the princes; Aslan came later and was ranked below them. You should understand this.

s0028.literal: " Another edict ordered Prince Touliangge and others to lead troops into Goryeo's old capital; Tuoduo'er and Jiao Tianyi were made darughachi of that country, and Chŏn was escorted home.
s0028.idiomatic: Another edict ordered Prince Touliangge and others to march into Goryeo's old capital. Tuoduo'er and Jiao Tianyi were made darughachi of the country, and Chŏn was escorted home.

s0029.literal: A further edict was issued: "Lin Yan's deposition and enthronement are crimes that cannot be pardoned.
s0029.idiomatic: A further edict declared, "Lin Yan's deposition and enthronement are unpardonable crimes.

s0030.literal: Prince of Anqing Chŏ had no choice in the matter and is to be broadly forgiven.
s0030.idiomatic: Prince of Anqing Chŏ acted under compulsion and is to be broadly forgiven.

s0031.literal: Whoever can seize and deliver Yan, even if formerly in his faction, will surely receive a great increase in rank.
s0031.idiomatic: Whoever captures Yan and delivers him up, even if once among his faction, will receive a substantial promotion.

s0032.literal: " Crown Prince Chŏm memorialized asking to remain at court and marry an imperial princess; this was not granted, and he was ordered to return with his father.
s0032.idiomatic: Crown Prince Chŏm asked to remain at court and marry an imperial princess. The request was refused, and he was ordered to return with his father.

s0033.literal: Third month, gengzi new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
s0033.idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon of the third month the sun was eclipsed.

s0034.literal: The branch secretariats of Henan and other routes, the Shaanxi Five Routes, Western Shu, Sichuan, and Dongjing and other routes were changed to branch ministries of revenue.
s0034.idiomatic: Branch secretariats in Henan and other routes, the Shaanxi Five Routes, Western Shu, Sichuan, and Dongjing and other routes were converted to branch ministries of revenue.

s0035.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials stated: "For government grain purchases in Hexi, Buddhist clergy, powerful officials, and wealthy households should all be treated alike.
s0035.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials reported that in Hexi government grain purchases should apply equally to Buddhist clergy, powerful officials, and wealthy households.

s0037.literal: On jiayin day, the imperial carriage visited Shangdu.
s0037.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Emperor traveled to Shangdu.

s0038.literal: On bingchen day, the imperial canal at Wuqing County was dredged.
s0038.idiomatic: On bingchen day the imperial canal at Wuqing County was dredged.

s0039.literal: On dingsi day, the ranks of medical officials were fixed.
s0039.idiomatic: On dingsi day the ranks of medical officials were fixed.

s0040.literal: On wuwu day, Yidu, Deng, and Lai suffered locusts and drought; an edict reduced this year's household silver levy by half.
s0040.idiomatic: On wuwu day locusts and drought struck Yidu, Deng, and Lai; an edict cut this year's household silver levy in half.

s0041.literal: Aju and Liu Zheng stated: "To besiege and hold Xiangyang, training the navy and building war vessels must come first.
s0041.idiomatic: Aju and Liu Zheng argued that to hold Xiangyang under siege, training the navy and building war vessels had to come first.

s0043.literal: More than seventy thousand men were trained for the navy, and five thousand war vessels were built.
s0043.idiomatic: More than seventy thousand men were trained for the navy and five thousand war vessels built.

s0044.literal: Summer, fourth month, renyang day: in Tan Prefecture black frost fell for two nights.
s0044.idiomatic: On renyang day in the fourth month of summer black frost fell at Tan Prefecture for two nights.

s0045.literal: Professors of Mongol script schools were appointed on all routes.
s0045.idiomatic: Professors were appointed for Mongol script schools on every route.

s0046.literal: An edict stated: "On all routes, sons of darughachi are to inherit appointment as darughachi of scattered prefectures and subordinate prefectures; sons of darughachi of scattered prefectures and subordinate prefectures are to fill county darughachi posts; and sons of county darughachi are to fill patrol-inspector posts."
s0046.idiomatic: An edict ordered that on every route sons of darughachi should inherit posts as darughachi of scattered prefectures and subordinate prefectures, sons of those darughachi should fill county darughachi posts, and sons of county darughachi should become patrol inspectors.

s0047.literal: The Censorate clerk was changed to secretary.
s0047.idiomatic: The censorate clerk's title was changed to secretary.

s0048.literal: On guiwei day, military officer grades were fixed: wanhu, zongguan, qianhu, baihu, and zongba were differentiated by number of soldiers.
s0048.idiomatic: On guiwei day military officer grades were fixed: wanhu, zongguan, qianhu, baihu, and zongba were ranked by the number of soldiers under command.

s0049.literal: On jichou day, Zhongnan County was merged into Zhouzhi; Zanhuang County of Zhending and Leping County of Taiyuan were restored.
s0049.idiomatic: On jichou day Zhongnan County was merged into Zhouzhi, and Zanhuang County in Zhending and Leping County in Taiyuan were restored.

s0050.literal: The Goryeo Branch Secretariat sent envoys to report: "The powerful minister Lin Yan is dead; his son Weimao seized the Commandery Duke's post on his own authority and was killed by Minister Song Zongli.
s0050.idiomatic: The Goryeo branch secretariat sent envoys reporting that powerful minister Lin Yan was dead, his son Weimao had seized the commandery duke's post on his own authority, and Minister Song Zongli had killed him.

s0051.literal: The people on the island have all surrendered and have already been moved to the old capital.
s0051.idiomatic: The island's people had all surrendered and were already being moved to the old capital.

s0052.literal: Yan's faction, Pei Zhongsun and others, again gathered the remaining forces, enthroned a collateral kinsman of Chŏn, the Marquis of Chenghua, as king, and fled into Jin Island."
s0052.idiomatic: Yan's followers, Pei Zhongsun and others, rallied the remnant forces, enthroned Chŏn's collateral kinsman the Marquis of Chenghua as king, and fled to Jin Island."

s0053.literal: Fifth month, xinchou day: Henan County of Huai Prefecture suffered heavy hail.
s0053.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the fifth month Henan County in Huai Prefecture was struck by heavy hail.

s0054.literal: On guimao day, Shaanxi Branch Secretariat officials Yesudai'er and Yan Zhongfan, together with the eastern and western Chuan army commands, led troops against Song forces at Jiading, Chongqing, Diaoyu Mountain, and the Ma River; all were defeated, three stockades were taken, commander Niu Xuan was captured, and captives of people, horses, cattle, and war vessels were beyond counting.
s0054.idiomatic: On guimao day Shaanxi branch officials Yesudai'er and Yan Zhongfan, with the eastern and western Chuan army commands, fought Song forces at Jiading, Chongqing, Diaoyu Mountain, and the Ma River, defeated them all, took three stockades, captured commander Niu Xuan, and seized untold numbers of people, horses, cattle, and war vessels.

s0055.literal: On jiachen day, eight thousand households of the Rufeng River Fan tribes of Weizhou submitted; their chieftains came to court, received imperial patents, and were granted gold tallies.
s0055.idiomatic: On jiachen day eight thousand households of the Rufeng River Fan tribes in Weizhou submitted; their chieftains came to court, received imperial patents, and were given gold tallies.

s0056.literal: On dingwei day, the Dongjing Route suffered famine and was also worn down by grain transport and shipbuilding labor; this year's silk and silver levies were remitted by three-tenths.
s0056.idiomatic: On dingwei day famine struck the Dongjing route, which was also exhausted by grain transport and shipbuilding labor; this year's silk and silver levies were cut by three-tenths.

s0057.literal: Associate Privy Councillor Heda was made Grand Councillor.
s0057.idiomatic: Associate privy councillor Heda was made grand councillor.

s0058.literal: On yimao day, Funing County of Pingluan Route was restored, with Haishan and Changli attached to it.
s0058.idiomatic: On yimao day Funing County in Pingluan Route was restored, with Haishan and Changli placed under it.

s0059.literal: On bingchen day, households throughout the realm were registered.
s0059.idiomatic: On bingchen day households throughout the realm were registered.

s0060.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials stated: "Annual revenue from all routes is fifty thousand ingots of silver; we fear this will exhaust the people — it should be reduced by one-tenth.
s0060.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials reported that annual revenue from all routes totaled fifty thousand ingots of silver and feared this exhausted the people; it should be cut by one-tenth.

s0061.literal: Salaries of transport commission officials should match those of civilian officials; depot officials should receive measured rations, and offices were forbidden to take excess from the people. At year's end gains and losses would be compared and promotions and demotions applied.
s0061.idiomatic: Transport commission salaries should match civilian officials'; depot officials should receive measured rations, and offices were forbidden to overcharge the people. At year's end results would be compared and officials promoted or demoted accordingly.

s0062.literal: Shangdu lies far inland and travel for merchants is difficult; taxes are specially waived to favor them, except that for market trade in houses, land, slaves, and livestock the usual deed and stamp fees are collected.
s0062.idiomatic: Because Shangdu lay far inland and travel was hard for merchants, taxes there were specially waived, except that market trade in houses, land, slaves, and livestock still paid the usual deed and stamp fees.

s0063.literal: Transfers of civilian officials came every thirty months; with such frequent change minds grew careless — henceforth transfers are requested at sixty months.
s0063.idiomatic: Civilian officials had rotated every thirty months, and the constant change bred carelessness; henceforth transfers were set at sixty months.

s0064.literal: When princes send envoys to demand goods, relay horses, and the like, from now on written documents are required; oral commands are not permitted.
s0064.idiomatic: When princes sent envoys to demand goods, relay horses, and the like, written documents would henceforth be required and oral commands forbidden.

s0066.literal: The Palace Provision Commission was changed to the Office of Imperial Entertainments, rank 3a; Palace Provision Commissioner Xianzhen was made Director of Imperial Entertainments.
s0066.idiomatic: The palace provision commission became the Office of Imperial Entertainments, rank 3a, with palace provision commissioner Xianzhen as its director.

s0067.literal: On gengshen day, the Privy Council was ordered to verify troop numbers.
s0067.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Privy Council was ordered to verify troop numbers.

s0068.literal: On renxu day, Dongping Prefecture presented auspicious wheat — one stalk each bearing two ears, three ears, and five ears.
s0068.idiomatic: On renxu day Dongping Prefecture presented auspicious wheat, one stalk each with two, three, and five ears.

s0069.literal: The Capital Falconry and Hunting Commission was merged into the Ministry of Works.
s0069.idiomatic: The capital falconry and hunting commission was merged into the Ministry of Works.

s0070.literal: Silkworms and mulberry were ruined in Daming, Dongping, and other routes; locusts struck Nanjing, Henan, and other routes; this year's silver and silk levies were reduced by three-tenths.
s0070.idiomatic: Silkworms and mulberry failed in Daming, Dongping, and other routes, and locusts struck Nanjing, Henan, and other routes; this year's silver and silk levies were cut by three-tenths.

s0071.literal: Sixth month, bingzi day: an edict ordered purchase of five hundred horses at the Zhongxing market in Western Xia.
s0071.idiomatic: On bingzi day in the sixth month an edict ordered five hundred horses purchased at the Zhongxing market in Western Xia.

s0072.literal: On gengchen day, an edict stated: "When garrison troops return, those lacking food or falling ill are to be given food and medicine by the heads of the states, cities, villages, and wards they pass through.
s0072.idiomatic: On gengchen day an edict ordered that when garrison troops returned, those without food or those who fell ill were to receive food and medicine from the heads of the states, cities, villages, and wards they passed through.

s0073.literal: " On dinghai day, smelting directorates on all routes were abolished, and transport commissions were ordered to administer them concurrently.
s0073.idiomatic: On dinghai day smelting directorates on all routes were abolished and their duties assigned to transport commissions.

s0074.literal: Artisans of Qian Prefecture were moved to Songshan and given oxen and tools.
s0074.idiomatic: Artisans of Qian Prefecture were moved to Songshan and given oxen and tools.

s0075.literal: Prince Namuhem was granted six thousand horses, three thousand oxen, and ten thousand sheep.
s0075.idiomatic: Prince Namuhem received six thousand horses, three thousand oxen, and ten thousand sheep.

s0076.literal: Northern frontier garrison troops were granted twenty thousand horses, one thousand oxen, and fifty thousand sheep.
s0076.idiomatic: Northern frontier garrison troops received twenty thousand horses, one thousand oxen, and fifty thousand sheep.

s0077.literal: On bingshen day, sacrificial fields were established southeast of the capital.
s0077.idiomatic: On bingshen day sacrificial fields were established southeast of the capital.

s0078.literal: Private entry into Song territory for plunder was forbidden.
s0078.idiomatic: Private raids into Song territory were forbidden.

s0079.literal: Seventh month, autumn, xinchou day: the Superior Forest Office was established.
s0079.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the seventh month of autumn the Superior Forest Office was established.

s0080.literal: On yimao day, Prince Baidaham was granted a seal and two each of gyrfalcon and gold tallies.
s0080.idiomatic: On yimao day Prince Baidaham received a seal and two gyrfalcons and two gold tallies.

s0081.literal: On gengshen day, salaries for military officers were first granted.
s0081.idiomatic: On gengshen day military officers received salaries for the first time.

s0082.literal: On renxu day, Muslim troops on all circuits were conscripted.
s0082.idiomatic: On renxu day Muslim troops on every circuit were conscripted.

s0083.literal: On yichou day, catapult-household registers on all routes were verified.
s0083.idiomatic: On yichou day catapult-household registers on every route were verified.

s0084.literal: Grand Marshal Yesudai'er and others raided Guang Prefecture and defeated Song troops at Jingang Terrace.
s0084.idiomatic: Grand marshal Yesudai'er and others raided Guang Prefecture and defeated Song troops at Jingang Terrace.

s0085.literal: The Liaodong Kaiyuan and other route zongguan offices were ordered to administer their route transport commissions concurrently.
s0085.idiomatic: The Liaodong Kaiyuan and other route zongguan offices were ordered to run their route transport commissions concurrently.

s0086.literal: Drought and locusts struck Shandong routes.
s0086.idiomatic: Drought and locusts struck the Shandong routes.

s0087.literal: Military-household land rent was remitted, and frontier garrison troops were issued grain.
s0087.idiomatic: Land rent for military households was remitted, and frontier garrison troops were issued grain.

s0088.literal: Darughachi Uryangqadai was ordered to issue grain for the hunting retinue at Shangdu.
s0088.idiomatic: Darughachi Uryangqadai was ordered to issue grain for the hunting retinue at Shangdu.

s0089.literal: Eighth month, wuchen new moon: encircling walls were built to press Xiangyang.
s0089.idiomatic: On the wuchen new moon of the eighth month encircling walls were built to tighten the siege of Xiangyang.

s0090.literal: On jisi day, famine in Yingchang Prefecture was relieved.
s0090.idiomatic: On jisi day famine relief was issued in Yingchang Prefecture.

s0091.literal: Prince Baidaham's retainers reported famine; those with horses and carts were ordered to move to Huanghu'er Yuliang and receive grain by head count, while those without horses and carts were to find food in Su, Sha, and Gan Prefectures.
s0091.idiomatic: Prince Baidaham's retainers reported famine. Those with horses and carts were moved to Huanghu'er Yuliang and given grain by head count; those without were sent to find food in Su, Sha, and Gan Prefectures.

s0092.literal: On wuyin day, Longxing Prefecture zongguan Cila Ot was dismissed for embezzling government funds.
s0092.idiomatic: On wuyin day Cila Ot, zongguan of Longxing Prefecture, was dismissed for embezzling government funds.

s0093.literal: On gengchen day, Censor-in-Chief Tachar was made Associate Privy Councillor, and Vice Censor-in-Chief Tiezhi was made Censor-in-Chief.
s0093.idiomatic: On gengchen day censor-in-chief Tachar became associate privy councillor, and vice censor-in-chief Tiezhi became censor-in-chief.

s0094.literal: Goryeo Crown Prince Wang Chŏm came to congratulate the Emperor's birthday.
s0094.idiomatic: Goryeo crown prince Wang Chŏm came to congratulate the Emperor on his birthday.

s0095.literal: On xinsi day, officials of Yingchang Prefecture were established.
s0095.idiomatic: On xinsi day officials were established for Yingchang Prefecture.

s0096.literal: On xinmao day, Baoding Route suffered prolonged rain that damaged the crops.
s0096.idiomatic: On xinmao day prolonged rain in Baoding Route damaged the crops.

s0097.literal: Ninth month, gengzi day: an edict ordered that Buddhist clergy, Daoist clergy, and Nestorian Christians who kept wives and families and did not observe discipline be registered as civilians.
s0097.idiomatic: On gengzi day in the ninth month an edict ordered Buddhist clergy, Daoist clergy, and Nestorian Christians who kept wives and families and ignored discipline to be registered as civilians.

s0098.literal: On dingsi day, the moon infringed upon Jing.
s0098.idiomatic: On dingsi day the moon infringed upon Jing.

s0099.literal: On bingyin day, Hexi households were registered and field taxes fixed.
s0099.idiomatic: On bingyin day Hexi households were registered and field taxes fixed.

s0100.literal: Song General Fan Wenhu came with two thousand warships to relieve Xiangyang; Aju, Heda, and Liu Zheng led troops to meet them in battle at Guanzitan, killed and plundered more than one thousand men, captured thirty vessels, and Wenhu withdrew.
s0100.idiomatic: Song general Fan Wenhu came with two thousand warships to relieve Xiangyang. Aju, Heda, and Liu Zheng met him at Guanzitan, killed and plundered more than one thousand men, captured thirty vessels, and Wenhu withdrew.
